summary: Tenant onboarding: cross-cloud access divergence prevents new team from assuming onboarding roles
description: Issue summary: New tenant onboarding automation failed when attempting to provision cross-account access for a Dedicated customer. Impact: onboarding blocked for 3 developer accounts for ~18 hours; automated workflows returned 403/AccessDenied when assuming AWS cross-account roles and IAM binding failures on GCP side. Background: onboarding uses a combined GCP service-account -> workload identity -> AWS STS chaining pattern. Around 2026-03-10 03:20 UTC the onboarding job started failing for customer org 'acme-analytics' after a recent terraform module bump to 'infra-iam-v2'.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger onboarding pipeline for new tenant (repo: infra/onboarding, pipeline: onboarding-prod)
2) Observe terraform apply step that creates GCP service account and Workload Identity Pool binding failing with 403s
3) Subsequent step attempts to assume AWS role (arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/redwood-onboard-tenant) using STS assumed role from GCP -> see AccessDenied
4) Re-run with debug env to capture cloud audit logs and terraform plan output
logs: terraform-plan-output: module.onboarding.google_service_account_iam_binding.removed -> attempted change to role 'roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser' on service account but condition block omitted
aws-sts: 2026-03-10T03:27:45Z AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity failed: AccessDenied (Missing principal tag: 'x-redwood-org' in trust-policy condition)
onboarding-pipeline: step 'attach-crosscloud-role' exitcode=1 - 'AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource'

console-lookup: GCP console shows missing binding 'principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/onboarding-pool/subjects/sa:acme-onboard@acme-analytics.iam.gserviceaccount.com'
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: infra-iam-v2 module removed conditional principal mapping needed for tenant orgs (org id constraint).
Checked terraform module change (PR #1428) — maintainer simplified WIP binding and replaced conditional 'principalOrgID' with a static principal which broke multi-tenant subject mapping.

GCP side: service account was created but iam.policy did not include 'roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser' for the expected workload identity subject. The terraform diff shows a missing 'condition.expression' which previously injected 'principalSet://projects/.../namespaces/acme-analytics'.

AWS side: trust policy for redwood-onboard-tenant role includes a Condition: StringEquals: { 'sts:ExternalId': '<generated>' } and StringLike on 'aws:PrincipalTag/x-redwood-org' — the GCP-to-AWS tag propagation depends on the WIF binding. Since GCP binding was incomplete the tag wasn't present, causing sts:AssumeRole to fail.
Reproduced in staging by applying patched terraform (local change) which restored the conditional mapping; staging onboarding succeeded end-to-end.

Liam O'Connor (Assignee) 2026-03-10: I reproduced failure locally; collecting audit logs and checking PR #1428 to see what changed in infra-iam-v2 module
SRE Alice Romero 2026-03-10: Noted spike in onboarding pipeline errors around 03:20 UTC. Linking stackdriver trace: https://console.cloud.google.com/traces/traceid/onboarding-prod (redacted)
Infra owner (DevOps) 2026-03-11: Confirmed PR #1428 removed 'principalOrgID' template accidentally. Preparing hotfix PR to reinstate dynamic subject condition.
Security (Nima Patel) 2026-03-11: Reviewed proposed change; added requirement to include explicit audit log entry when creating cross-cloud trust to aid future debugging.

Liam O'Connor 2026-03-12: Hotfix merged (PR #1439), pipeline re-run succeeded for acme-analytics. Created temporary mitigation: fallback to per-tenant service-account (manual) while module fix propagates.
resolution: Root cause: regression in infra-iam-v2 terraform module removed dynamic Workload Identity subject condition used to propagate tenant org tags into cross-cloud token exchange. Fix: reverted the module change and reintroduced the conditional principal mapping (PR #1439). Deployed hotfix to prod us-east; onboarding jobs retried and completed. Follow-ups: 1) add unit tests for WIF subject templates in infra module, 2) add instrumentation that logs the generated subject string into onboarding pipeline artifacts, 3) update onboarding runbook with manual rollback steps.
